title: Map with char arithmetic
prompt: Implement `String shout(String s)`: uppercase every lowercase letter using char arithmetic (no `toUpperCase`), leaving everything else untouched. Trace 'c' → 2 → 'C' before coding.

tests.name: mapped to upper
tests.hint: if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') out += (char)(c - 'a' + 'A'); else out += c;
